knowledge_graph.title: McCowan Retirement Residence - Metta Lifestyles
knowledge_graph.address: 2881 Eglinton Ave E, Scarborough, ON M1J 0A2, Canada
knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "Metta Lifestyles' McCowan retirement home offers our residents the ability to plan their days as they see fit. We are located in the east end of the city, close to transit, shopping and beautiful walking trails. Our home offers many amenities to keep everyone healthy, happy and entertained. ​ McCowan offers a wide range of services. Your lifestyle is built around your needs. Our main care programs are our Assisted Living and Metta Memory services."

posts.description:
We believe in providing a vibrant and supportive environment tailored for seniors with dementia. Our Memory Care program focuses on stimulating cognitive functions, promoting social connections, and enhancing overall well-being through personalized, innovative activities.

Residents benefit from a holistic approach to care that touches every aspect of their daily life. Meals, activities, and social interactions are thoughtfully integrated, ensuring that each resident is constantly engaged, stimulated, and supported. By focusing on what individuals can do rather than their limitations, we create opportunities for meaningful participation and connection. 

 #memorycare #seniorcare #seniorliving #retirementhome #retirementresidence #enhancedcare #assistedliving #assistance #seniors

Feel secure with our Enhanced Care services. Our ability to provide the highest levels of care within a retirement community is what makes Metta so unique. Very few retirement homes can match the levels of care that we can provide. We call this our Enhanced Care program.

Our Enhanced Care bridges the gap between medium assistance and full 24/7 assistance. Typically, the services that fall under "Enhanced" require skilled nursing staff or higher levels of attention, help or equipment.  
  
At Metta, we’re dedicated to ensuring that your loved one receives the care they need when they need it.

 #memorycare #seniorcare #seniorliving #retirementhome #retirementresidence #enhancedcare #assistedliving #assistance #seniors

Our staff are trained in Gentle Persuasive Approaches (GPA) and LOFT community services. These programs equip our team with advanced, compassionate techniques to support residents living with dementia. We focus on understanding behaviour and responding with empathy, dignity, and respect. We also complete annual recertification to ensure we’re always learning and improving the way we care.
Many of our staff have been part of our communities for decades, bringing kindness, expertise, and deep understanding to every interaction. With personalized activities and a strong focus on dignity and engagement, families can feel peace of mind knowing their loved one is in skilled, compassionate hands. We provide a safe, nurturing environment where residents feel truly valued and connected. We take the time to learn their stories, creating not just a place to live — but a place that feels like home.

From personalized memory care to dedicated high-level support, our community is committed to being a place where you can truly feel at home—today and in the future.

Discover the peace of mind that comes with care tailored to your journey.

What sets us apart?

Our caregivers are trained in Gentle Persuasive Approaches (GPA) and LOFT community services. These programs equip our team with advanced, compassionate techniques to support residents living with dementia. We focus on understanding behaviour and responding with empathy, dignity, and respect. We also complete annual recertification to ensure we’re always learning and improving the way we care.

We believe every day holds meaning and every moment offers a chance to shine.

Purpose is the heart of life—it gives every day meaning and makes our journey richer and fuller. Our memory care program is dedicated to creating a nurturing environment where residents can find purpose and joy through personalized activities, meaningful connections, and compassionate support. By honoring each individual’s unique story and abilities, we help them engage in ways that inspire confidence, comfort, and fulfillment.

Feel secure with our enhanced care program. If your loved one requires more care than traditional retirement homes are able to provide, our enhanced care may be what you need.
Enhanced care bridges the gap between medium assistance and full 24/7 assistance. Typically, these services require skilled nursing staff or higher levels of attention, help or equipment.    
At Metta, all of our homes are designed to ensure that your loved one receives the care they need when they need it. When you meet with a Metta team member for a consultation or an assessment, we can advise you of the services you or your loved one may need and want.

Thank you to our outstanding PSWs, who brighten our residence. You walk alongside our residents with patience, compassion, and understanding. You offer not just care, but comfort, trust, and connection.
On PSW Day, we honour the beautiful, quiet moments you create each day: a reassuring smile, a gentle touch, a kind word. You help make every day meaningful for those we serve. Thank you for your devotion and the love you pour into every moment.
